current.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
current.description: A 2,500-year-old shrine to Goddess Meenakshi, crowned by fourteen soaring gopurams covered in thousands of vivid sculptures. Few places on earth feel as alive with devotion, music and colour.

previous.name: Kamakshi Amman Temple
previous.description: The presiding shrine of Kanchipuram — the very town whose looms give us the Kanjivaram. A quiet, golden-toned temple whose motifs still travel from wall to warp.
